title: Personal Costs of Executive Turnovers
title_zh: 高管更替的个人成本
title_primary: 高管更替的个人成本
title_secondary: Personal Costs of Executive Turnovers
authors: KASPER MEISNER NIELSEN
official: 官方在线 2026-08-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines the income loss following forced CEO turnovers using income data from the official records at the Danish Tax Authority. We find that dismissed CEOs’ personal income is 40% lower in the five years following forced turnovers. The decline is driven by labor market outcomes: labor and entrepreneurial incomes decline, while other sources of income increase. We find larger declines in income for executives with poor performance during their tenures, consistent with the executive labor market being the main channel for the lower income. Overall, the findings suggest that executives face significant personal costs from forced turnovers.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用丹麦税务局官方记录的收入数据，考察了强制CEO更替后的收入损失。我们发现，被解雇CEO在强制更替后五年内的个人收入降低了40%。这一下降主要由劳动力市场结果驱动：劳动收入和创业收入减少，而其他收入来源增加。我们发现，任期内表现不佳的高管收入下降幅度更大，这与高管劳动力市场是收入降低的主要渠道相一致。总体而言，研究结果表明，高管因强制更替而面临显著的个人成本。

title: Co-exportation of products by multi-product firms
title_zh: 多产品企业的产品协同出口
title_primary: 多产品企业的产品协同出口
title_secondary: Co-exportation of products by multi-product firms
authors: Peter H. Egger, Corinne L. Jones, Leandro Navarro
official: 官方在线 2026-08-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The attention on multi-product firms has focused primarily on firms’ product scope, i.e., how many products firms sell, rather than on which products they co-produce and sell. We address this by developing a stochastic heterogeneous-firm model that allows for correlations in production efficiencies across products and in consumers’ tastes across products and destinations. Our estimation strategy centers on a novel extension of generalized score matching. We use Chinese export data for the leather sector. The estimates reveal a clustered co-exportation structure consistent with correlated efficiency shocks across products sharing similar production processes.
abstract_zh: 关于多产品企业的研究，主要聚焦于企业的产品范围，即企业销售多少种产品，而非它们共同生产和销售哪些产品。我们通过构建一个随机异质性企业模型来解决这一问题，该模型允许不同产品间的生产效率以及不同产品和目的地间的消费者偏好存在相关性。我们的估计策略围绕广义得分匹配的一种新颖扩展展开。我们利用中国皮革行业的出口数据。估计结果显示，存在一种聚类共出口结构，这与共享相似生产流程的产品间效率冲击的相关性相一致。

title: From Access to Achievement: The Primary School-Age Impacts of an At-Scale Preschool Construction Program in Highly Deprived Communities
title_zh: 从入学到成就：高度贫困社区大规模学前教育建设项目的学龄儿童影响
title_primary: 从入学到成就：高度贫困社区大规模学前教育建设项目的学龄儿童影响
title_secondary: From Access to Achievement: The Primary School-Age Impacts of an At-Scale Preschool Construction Program in Highly Deprived Communities
authors: Bassi, Marina, Besbas, Bruno, Dinarte-Diaz, Lelys, Ravindran, Saravana, Reynoso, Ana
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We evaluate a large-scale public preschool construction program in deprived rural communities in Mozambique using a randomized control trial. The program increased preschool enrollment from 2% to 75%, improved primary school enrollment and progression, and led treated children to score higher in cognitive and social-emotional skills tests. Impacts were strongest among children of illiterate parents, in less poor households, and living near the preschools. We provide evidence that preschool construction mediates later educational success at primary school-age. We also detect increased parental investment in children and higher preschool enrollment for younger siblings. Finally, we estimate the program was implemented cost-effectively.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一项随机对照试验，评估了莫桑比克贫困农村社区大规模公立幼儿园建设项目。该项目使幼儿园入学率从2%提升至75%，改善了小学入学率与学业进展，并促使受助儿童在认知与社会情感技能测试中取得更高分数。影响在父母为文盲、家庭贫困程度较低且居住地邻近幼儿园的儿童中最为显著。我们提供了证据表明，幼儿园建设通过中介效应促进了儿童在小学阶段的教育成就。同时，研究还发现该项目增加了父母对子女的投入，并提高了弟弟妹妹的幼儿园入学率。最后，我们估算该项目的实施具有成本效益。

title: Marriage, Fertility, and Cultural Integration in Italy
title_zh: 意大利的婚姻、生育与文化融合
title_primary: 意大利的婚姻、生育与文化融合
title_secondary: Marriage, Fertility, and Cultural Integration in Italy
authors: Bisin, Alberto, Tura, Giulia
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study cultural integration as an equilibrium outcome of marital matching along cultural and education lines and intra-household investment decisions regarding fertility and cultural socialization. Our model allows us to identify cultural-ethnic group specific investment parameters and spousal preferences for marital matching. Structural estimates reveal a strong demand to preserve cultural identity on the part of immigrants and limited acceptance of the immigrants’ cultural diversity on the part of natives. Furthermore, these estimates reveal a substantial heterogeneity of the parental value of children’s education across cultures. Nonetheless, our estimates simulate substantial - though heterogeneous- cultural integration rates across immigrant groups.
abstract_zh: 我们将文化融合视为婚姻匹配在文化与教育维度上的均衡结果，以及家庭内部关于生育与文化社会化的投资决策。我们的模型能够识别特定文化族群的投资参数及配偶对婚姻匹配的偏好。结构估计显示，移民群体对保持文化身份具有强烈诉求，而本土居民对移民文化多样性的接纳程度有限。此外，这些估计揭示了不同文化背景下父母对子女教育价值的显著异质性。尽管如此，我们的模拟结果表明，各移民群体间存在显著但具有异质性的文化融合率。

title: Taxation and Supplier Networks: Evidence from India
title_zh: 税收与供应商网络：来自印度的证据
title_primary: 税收与供应商网络：来自印度的证据
title_secondary: Taxation and Supplier Networks: Evidence from India
authors: Gadenne, Lucie, Nandi, Tushar K., Rathelot, Roland
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper considers how tax policy affects supply chains in a developing economy. Using administrative panel data on firms and transactions between them, we document substantial segmentation of supply chains between firms paying Value-Added Taxes (VAT) and non-VAT-paying firms. We then develop a model of firms' sourcing and tax decisions within supply chains to understand how tax policy interacts with supply networks. Finally, we test the model's predictions using variations over time within firm and within supplier-client pairs. We find that the tax system distorts firms' sourcing decisions, and evidence of strategic complementarities in firms' tax choices within supplier networks.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨税收政策如何影响发展中国家的供应链。利用企业及其交易往来的行政面板数据，我们记录了增值税纳税企业与非增值税纳税企业之间供应链的显著分割现象。随后，我们构建了一个关于企业在供应链中采购与税务决策的模型，以理解税收政策如何与供应网络相互作用。最后，我们利用企业层面及供应商-客户配对层面的时间变化来检验模型的预测。研究发现，税收体系扭曲了企业的采购决策，并揭示了供应商网络中企业税务选择存在战略互补性的证据。

title: The Impact of Margaret Sanger’s Birth Control Clinics on Early 20th Century US Fertility and Mortality
title_zh: 玛格丽特·桑格避孕诊所在20世纪初美国生育率与死亡率中的影响
title_primary: 玛格丽特·桑格避孕诊所在20世纪初美国生育率与死亡率中的影响
title_secondary: The Impact of Margaret Sanger’s Birth Control Clinics on Early 20th Century US Fertility and Mortality
authors: Bauernschuster, Stefan, Grimm, Michael, Hajo, Cathy Moran
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Economic Policy · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: In 1916, Margaret Sanger established the first birth control clinic in US history. From the mid-1920s, “Sanger clinics” spread over the entire US These clinics advised women on contraception, mainly by fitting diaphragms and explicitly instructing women how to use them effectively. Combining newly digitized data on the roll-out of these clinics, full-count Census data, and historical vital statistics, we find that the clinics accounted for 5.4–6.5 percent of the overall fertility decline across the US until 1940. By increasing the spacing between births and reducing fertility, the clinics generated important health effects and reduced stillbirths and infant mortality.
abstract_zh: 1916年，玛格丽特·桑格在美国历史上建立了第一家节育诊所。自20世纪20年代中期起，“桑格诊所”遍布全美。这些诊所为女性提供避孕指导，主要通过安装子宫托并明确指导女性如何有效使用。结合新近数字化的诊所推广数据、全量人口普查数据及历史生命统计资料，我们发现，截至1940年，这些诊所对美国整体生育率下降的贡献率为5.4%至6.5%。通过延长生育间隔并降低生育率，诊所产生了重要的健康效应，减少了死产和婴儿死亡率。

title: Evaluation and Assignment with Networked Competition and Spillovers
title_zh: 网络竞争与溢出效应下的评估与分配
title_primary: 网络竞争与溢出效应下的评估与分配
title_secondary: Evaluation and Assignment with Networked Competition and Spillovers
authors: Antonio Cabrales, Wenhao Cheng
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies how organizations should jointly design evaluation rules and assign workers when performance depends on both effort and non-discretionary advantage. Agents choose effort in positions linked by a competition network, while their effective advantage depends on own type and spillovers through a second network. The planner chooses both the assignment and the effort weight in evaluation. Equilibrium effort rises with a position’s Katz-Bonacich centrality and falls with effective advantage. The optimal evaluation rule generally differs from true output. When effort is more important in production, the planner lowers the effort weight and uses negative assortative assignment to strengthen incentives. When advantage is more important, the planner raises the effort weight and uses positive assortative assignment to exploit spillovers. We also study a constraint requiring assignments to be pairwise stable, which creates an output loss depending on the intensity of competition.
abstract_zh: 本文研究当绩效同时取决于努力与非自主优势时，组织应如何联合设计评估规则并分配岗位。代理人通过竞争网络关联的岗位选择努力水平，而其有效优势则取决于自身类型及通过另一网络产生的溢出效应。规划者需同时决定岗位分配方案及评估中的努力权重。均衡状态下，努力水平随岗位的卡茨-波纳奇中心度上升而提高，随有效优势上升而下降。最优评估规则通常与真实产出存在差异。当努力在生产中更为重要时，规划者会降低努力权重并采用负向匹配分配以强化激励；当优势更为重要时，规划者会提高努力权重并采用正向匹配分配以利用溢出效应。本文还研究了要求分配满足两两稳定性的约束条件，该约束会因竞争强度差异产生产出损失。

title: Country banks and the Panic of 1825
title_zh: 乡村银行与1825年恐慌
title_primary: 乡村银行与1825年恐慌
title_secondary: Country banks and the Panic of 1825
authors: Jane Olmstead-Rumsey, Giorgio Ravalli
official: 官方在线 2026-07-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The Panic of 1825 was a significant crisis in British financial history. We document how this crisis spread from London banks to England’s real economy. England’s correspondent banking network propagated trouble in sovereign debt markets to small banks outside of London and ultimately to non-financial firms. Using exogenous variation in district-level exposure to the crisis, we show that bank failures led to a substantial number of bankruptcies among non-financial firms. We discuss two potential mechanisms by which the financial system affected the real economy: a fall in aggregate demand and a credit supply shock.
abstract_zh: 1825年恐慌是英国金融史上一次重大危机。本文记录了这场危机如何从伦敦银行蔓延至英格兰实体经济。英格兰的代理银行网络将主权债务市场的困境传导至伦敦以外的小型银行，并最终波及非金融企业。利用各地区危机暴露程度的外生差异，我们证明银行倒闭导致非金融企业破产数量大幅增加。本文探讨了金融体系影响实体经济的两种潜在机制：总需求下降与信贷供给冲击。

title: Decentralizing Development: The Economic Impacts of Government Splits
title_zh: 分散化发展：政府分裂的经济影响
title_primary: 分散化发展：政府分裂的经济影响
title_secondary: Decentralizing Development: The Economic Impacts of Government Splits
authors: Ricardo Dahis, Christiane Szerman
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Changes in political boundaries aimed at devolving power to local governments are common across many countries. We examine the economic impacts of government unit creation through splitting. Exploiting reforms that led to sharp increases in the number of municipalities in Brazil, we show that voluntary splitting enlarges the public sector, enhances public service delivery, and stimulates long-term economic activity in new local governments. These gains are not offset by losses elsewhere and are stronger in peripheral, remote, and underdeveloped areas neglected by parent governments. Higher fiscal revenues and decentralized decision-making contribute to the positive effects on local economic activity. (JEL D72, H41, H75, H76, H77, Q53, R51)
abstract_zh: 旨在将权力下放至地方政府而进行的政治边界调整在许多国家都很常见。本文通过分析政府单位拆分创建的影响，考察其经济效应。利用导致巴西城市数量急剧增加的改革，我们发现自愿拆分扩大了公共部门规模，提升了公共服务供给，并刺激了新地方政府长期的经济活动。这些收益并未被其他地区的损失所抵消，且在那些被原属政府忽视的边缘、偏远及欠发达地区更为显著。更高的财政收入与分散化决策对地方经济活动的积极效应起到了推动作用。（JEL D72, H41, H75, H76, H77, Q53, R51）

title: The economic and welfare effects of RCEP: A global value chain perspective
title_zh: RCEP的经济与福利效应：基于全球价值链视角
title_primary: RCEP的经济与福利效应：基于全球价值链视角
title_secondary: The economic and welfare effects of RCEP: A global value chain perspective
authors: Shuijun Peng, Lamei Wu, Shangyao Zhou, Jialin Xu, Bo Gao
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper quantifies the impact of the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) on global value chains (GVCs) and welfare. Using a multi-country, multi-sector general equilibrium model with global input-output linkages, we distinguish between tariffs on intermediate and final goods to capture the granular trade-cost dynamics of RCEP’s implementation. Our results show that RCEP significantly bolsters intra-regional trade and enhances complex GVC participation, although patterns of integration diverge: China and Australia expand primarily through forward linkages, while Japan, South Korea, and ASEAN members integrate more deeply through backward linkages. Welfare decomposition reveals that more than half of the total gains are driven by indirect channels, specifically intermediate-goods trade and sectoral linkages, rather than direct final-goods liberalization. Counterfactual simulations further demonstrate that RCEP serves as a critical strategic buffer against global trade disruptions. While the U.S.-China trade war and the emerging “Trump 2.0” reciprocal tariff regimes pose substantial risks, deeper regional integration and services liberalization can significantly mitigate these adverse welfare shocks. These findings underscore that RCEP functions as a strategic anchor for regional value chains, playing a pivotal role in bolstering supply-chain resilience against the structural shifts and heightened uncertainties of the global trade environment.
abstract_zh: 本文量化了《区域全面经济伙伴关系协定》（RCEP）对全球价值链（GVCs）及福利的影响。通过运用一个包含全球投入产出联系的多国、多部门一般均衡模型，我们区分了中间品与最终品的关税，以捕捉RCEP实施过程中细粒度的贸易成本动态。研究结果显示，RCEP显著促进了区域内贸易，并增强了复杂全球价值链的参与度，尽管一体化模式存在差异：中国和澳大利亚主要通过前向联系扩展，而日本、韩国及东盟成员国则通过后向联系实现更深入的一体化。福利分解表明，总收益中超过一半由间接渠道驱动，具体为中间品贸易和部门间联系，而非直接的最终品自由化。反事实模拟进一步证明，RCEP在应对全球贸易中断时充当关键的战略缓冲。尽管中美贸易战及新兴的“特朗普2.0”互惠关税体制构成重大风险，但更深层次的区域一体化与服务自由化能显著缓解这些不利的福利冲击。这些发现强调，RCEP作为区域价值链的战略锚点，在增强供应链韧性以应对全球贸易环境的结构性转变与不确定性加剧方面发挥着关键作用。

title: Clarifying overlapping land rights in semi-formal systems: The case of Mailo tenant lands in Uganda
title_zh: 厘清半正式体系中的重叠土地权利：乌干达Mailo租户土地案例
title_primary: 厘清半正式体系中的重叠土地权利：乌干达Mailo租户土地案例
title_secondary: Clarifying overlapping land rights in semi-formal systems: The case of Mailo tenant lands in Uganda
authors: Kate Marple-Cantrell, Heather Huntington, Daniel Ayalew Ali, Thea Hilhorst
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines the effects of clarifying overlapping land rights on Mailo land in Central Uganda, contributing to broader debates on property rights and rural development. The study leverages a quasi-experimental design implemented across three districts, where interventions included systematic demarcation of parcel boundaries and land inventories, dissemination of legal knowledge, conflict mediation services, and facilitation of tenant–landlord agreements. Drawing on a panel of Mailo tenants, a large-N tenant survey, and a survey of landlords, we assess how land rights awareness raising shaped institutional clarity (improved documentation and legal awareness), tenure security (reduced conflict and strengthened perceptions of security), and economic behavior (evidence of land market activity). The findings highlight the central role of annual Busuulu (ground rent) payments—functioning simultaneously as a rent obligation and as formal evidence of tenant rights—as a mechanism linking institutional reforms to greater tenure security and market participation. We further identify heterogeneous effects, with distinct patterns for female-headed households and for tenants with kinship ties to landlords on all three outcomes. Taken together, the results provide new evidence on the mechanisms through which property rights interventions shape security and economic activity in rural Africa.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了澄清乌干达中部梅洛土地重叠权属对制度明晰度、产权安全及经济行为的影响，为产权与农村发展的更广泛讨论提供了新证据。研究采用准实验设计，在三个地区实施干预措施，包括地块边界的系统划定与土地清册编制、法律知识传播、冲突调解服务以及促进租户与地主间协议达成。基于梅洛租户面板数据、大规模租户调查及地主调查，我们评估了土地权利意识提升如何塑造制度明晰度（改善文件记录与法律认知）、产权安全（减少冲突并强化安全感知）及经济行为（土地市场活动的证据）。研究结果凸显了年度布苏鲁（地租）支付的核心作用——其同时作为租金义务和租户权利的正式凭证——成为连接制度改革与增强产权安全及市场参与的关键机制。我们进一步识别出异质性效应，在女性户主家庭及与地主存在亲属关系的租户中，三项结果均呈现不同模式。总体而言，本研究为产权干预如何影响非洲农村安全与经济活动提供了机制层面的新证据。

title: How do ransomware groups choose their targets? An empirical analysis
title_zh: 勒索软件组织如何选择攻击目标？一项实证分析
title_primary: 勒索软件组织如何选择攻击目标？一项实证分析
title_secondary: How do ransomware groups choose their targets? An empirical analysis
authors: Tyler Moore, Neil Gandal, Dmytro Kashchuk
official: 官方在线 2026-06-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Ransomware groups vary in the types of organizations they compromise, yet little empirical work has examined whether these differences extend to the technology stacks of victims. We analyze 5,190 ransomware incidents across 151 groups, linking each victim to its observed technology stack from the SWDB Company Intelligence database. We find that some enterprise software is associated with greater ransomware risk than others, and that this association is often stronger for technologies carrying more known vulnerabilities. Next, by analyzing leaked chat logs of leading ransomware groups, we present direct evidence that some groups choose their victims based on observed technology use and revenue data gathered through opensource intelligence. Finally, examining the full population of victims, we find that some groups concentrate on particular technologies and revenue profiles, while others appear more opportunistic, with a victim profile close to the overall population.
abstract_zh: 勒索软件团伙在选择攻击目标时，其针对的组织类型存在差异，但鲜有实证研究探讨这些差异是否延伸至受害者的技术栈。我们分析了151个团伙涉及的5,190起勒索软件事件，将每个受害者与SWDB公司情报数据库中观测到的技术栈进行关联。研究发现，部分企业软件面临的勒索软件风险高于其他软件，且这种关联在已知漏洞较多的技术中往往更为显著。进一步通过分析主要勒索软件团伙泄露的聊天记录，我们提供了直接证据，表明部分团伙会基于开源情报收集到的技术使用情况和收入数据来选择受害者。最后，通过对全部受害者群体的分析，我们发现部分团伙专注于特定技术和收入特征，而其他团伙则更具机会主义倾向，其受害者特征与整体群体相近。

title: Regional Economic Impacts and Emission Responses under Solar Radiation Modification
title_zh: 太阳辐射干预下的区域经济影响与排放响应
title_primary: 太阳辐射干预下的区域经济影响与排放响应
title_secondary: Regional Economic Impacts and Emission Responses under Solar Radiation Modification
authors: Jenny Bjordal, Evelien van Dijk, Henri Cornec, Anthony A. Smith Jr., Trude Storelvmo
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Solar Radiation Modification (SRM) has been proposed as a potential tool to limit increases in global or regional temperatures caused by anthropogenic greenhouse gas emissions. While previous research has extensively examined the climate system’s response to various SRM strategies, as well as their aggregate economic consequences, the regional distribution of economic impacts has received less attention. In this study, we use NorESM2–DIAM—an Earth System Model coupled to a high-resolution integrated assessment model—to assess the economic impacts, measured in GDP per capita, in an idealised SRM scenario where incoming solar radiation is reduced by 1%. Our results suggest that, relative to a baseline without SRM, most countries experience economic gains under SRM, with only a few countries facing negative impacts. Low-income countries tend to see the largest benefits, reducing global economic inequality relative to the baseline. However, reduced damages and lower inequality are accompanied by higher emissions under SRM, potentially leading to additional adverse effects not captured here. These findings highlight potential trade-offs between economic benefits, reduced inequality, and increased emissions relevant for SRM governance.
abstract_zh: 太阳辐射管理（SRM）已被提出作为限制人为温室气体排放导致全球或区域气温升高的潜在工具。尽管已有研究广泛探讨了气候系统对不同SRM策略的响应及其总体经济后果，但经济影响的区域分布问题受到的关注较少。本研究利用耦合高分辨率综合评估模型的地球系统模型NorESM2–DIAM，评估了在理想化SRM情景（入射太阳辐射减少1%）下以人均GDP衡量的经济影响。结果表明：与未实施SRM的基准情景相比，大多数国家在SRM下获得经济收益，仅少数国家面临负面影响。低收入国家往往获得最大收益，从而降低了相对于基准情景的全球经济不平等。然而，SRM在减少损害和降低不平等的同时，也伴随着更高的排放量，可能引发本研究未涵盖的额外不利影响。这些发现揭示了SRM治理中经济收益、不平等减少与排放增加之间的潜在权衡关系。

title: Why Bloomington is not in Virginia: Contrasting the social ontologies, methodologies, and governance theories of the Ostroms and Buchanan
title_zh: 为何布卢明顿不在弗吉尼亚：奥斯特罗姆与布坎南的社会本体论、方法论及治理理论之对比
title_primary: 为何布卢明顿不在弗吉尼亚：奥斯特罗姆与布坎南的社会本体论、方法论及治理理论之对比
title_secondary: Why Bloomington is not in Virginia: Contrasting the social ontologies, methodologies, and governance theories of the Ostroms and Buchanan
authors: Massimo Cervesato
official: 官方在线 2026-06-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This article examines the ontological foundations of two major strands within the field of public choice: the Virginia school, led by James M. Buchanan, and the Bloomington school, represented by Elinor and Vincent Ostrom. Although their early collaboration was guided by a shared ambition, we argue that any attempt to subsume these two strands under a single theoretical framework is problematic. It risks overlooking a fundamental ontological divide regarding the nature of collective action and the so-called ‘constitutional moment.’ Buchanan’s framework, centered on exchange among rational individuals and the principle of unanimity, sharply contrasts with the Ostroms’ institutionalist approach, which emphasizes reciprocity and the formation of “communities of shared understanding” as the basis of collective action. These ontological differences underpin distinct methodological commitments to individualism, and ultimately entail important nuances in their approaches to public governance. Whereas Buchanan focuses on protecting individual liberty from government intrusion, the Ostroms highlight individuals’ capacity to engage directly in the governance of the public sector. In sum, since differences emerge at a fundamental level of their theoretical frameworks, any attempt to integrate them inevitably risks a reductive interpretation. Bloomington, after all, is not in Virginia.

title: Incentivising patient pathways in outpatient care: A review of gatekeeping and cost-sharing policies across the OECD
title_zh: 激励门诊患者就医路径：经合组织国家守门人制度与费用分摊政策综述

title_secondary: Incentivising patient pathways in outpatient care: A review of gatekeeping and cost-sharing policies across the OECD
authors: Manon Hämmerli, Ricarda Milstein, Michael Mueller
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Improving the efficient use of scarce resources is a key priority in many OECD countries to ensure the long-term sustainability of health spending. One option is to address the demand side by incentivising patients’ care-seeking behaviour. In this context, gatekeeping – a policy tool through which general practitioners (GPs) or other primary care physicians control access to specialist care, and cost-sharing – arrangements requiring patients to contribute financially to the cost of care, are two instruments frequently discussed. Both policy tools are widely applied across the OECD and may also pursue objectives beyond improving efficiency. Focusing on the outpatient sector, this Working Paper provides a stocktake of which OECD countries have these policies in place and how they are designed. It also reviews evidence on how these policies affect health care spending, efficiency and health outcomes. This is complemented by six country case studies that describe the implementation of gatekeeping and cost-sharing arrangements in detail and identify factors that can influence their impact on health system performance. These include the availability of GPs, how GPs are incentivised to deliver services, and whether patients can bypass gatekeeping pathways.
abstract_zh: 提高稀缺资源的有效利用是许多OECD国家确保卫生支出长期可持续性的关键优先事项。一种选择是通过激励患者的就医行为来调节需求侧。在此背景下，守门人制度——即全科医生或其他初级保健医生控制专科诊疗准入的政策工具，以及费用分摊——要求患者自付部分医疗费用的安排，是两种经常被讨论的手段。这两种政策工具在OECD国家中广泛应用，其目标可能不仅限于提升效率。本工作论文聚焦门诊领域，梳理了哪些OECD国家实施了这些政策及其具体设计方式，并综述了这些政策对卫生支出、效率及健康结局影响的实证证据。此外，通过六个国家案例研究，详细描述了守门人制度和费用分摊安排的实施情况，并识别了可能影响其对卫生系统绩效作用的关键因素，包括全科医生的可及性、全科医生提供服务的激励机制，以及患者能否绕过守门人路径。

title: Efficiency, Shadow Pricing and Regime Switching in Multi‐Ware Technologies: Evidence From Regulated Livestock Farms
title_zh: 多仓库技术中的效率、影子定价与制度转换：来自受监管畜牧场的证据
title_primary: 多仓库技术中的效率、影子定价与制度转换：来自受监管畜牧场的证据
title_secondary: Efficiency, Shadow Pricing and Regime Switching in Multi‐Ware Technologies: Evidence From Regulated Livestock Farms
authors: Youpei Yan, Robert G. Chambers
official: 官方在线 2026-05-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We develop a framework for regulated production systems where output generation and pollution abatement impose competing technological demands. Using a multi‐ware technology, we model the production set as the intersection of two input requirement frontiers, one for production and one for abatement, each reflecting distinct trade‐offs. We characterise the efficient set using gaps in efficiency distances and recover shadow prices for smooth and non‐smooth frontiers, clarifying how subdifferentials govern shadow prices at switching points. To address unobserved heterogeneity in technological orientation, we estimate a full‐information maximum likelihood model with endogenous regime‐switching. Applying the framework to Chinese livestock farms, we recover regime‐specific land costs, identify drivers of regime assignment and quantify inefficiency using multi‐ware distances. Results reveal sharp asymmetries in spatial burdens between production and abatement, and systematic switching behaviour driven by inputs and weather. Our framework offers a widely applicable, policy‐relevant tool for evaluating environmental and economic performance. JEL Classification: D24, Q12, Q52
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个受监管生产系统的分析框架，其中产出生成与污染减排对技术提出竞争性要求。通过采用多仓库技术，我们将生产集建模为两个投入需求前沿的交集——一个针对生产，另一个针对减排，各自反映不同的权衡关系。我们利用效率距离的缺口刻画有效集，并推导出光滑与非光滑前沿的影子价格，阐明次微分如何在切换点主导影子价格。为解决技术方向中未观测到的异质性，我们估计了一个包含内生机制切换的全信息最大似然模型。将该框架应用于中国畜牧养殖场，我们恢复了机制特定的土地成本，识别了机制分配的驱动因素，并利用多仓库距离量化了无效率。研究结果揭示了生产与减排之间空间负担的显著不对称性，以及由投入和天气驱动的系统性切换行为。我们的框架为评估环境与经济绩效提供了一个广泛适用且具有政策相关性的工具。JEL分类：D24, Q12, Q52

title: A Tractable Income Process for Business Cycle Analysis
title_zh: 一个适用于商业周期分析的可处理收入过程
title_primary: 一个适用于商业周期分析的可处理收入过程
title_secondary: A Tractable Income Process for Business Cycle Analysis
authors: Fatih Guvenen, Alisdair McKay, Conor Ryan
official: 官方在线 2026-05-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We estimate a tractable income process that is consistent with key facts on individual income risk and its variation over the business cycle. In particular, the estimated process generates income fluctuations that display (i) flat and acyclical variance, (ii) volatile and procyclical skewness, (iii) very high kurtosis, and (iv) a moderate rise in within-cohort inequality over the life cycle, all consistent with the US data. Furthermore, the income process captures the predictable nature of business cycle income risk: income changes during a business cycle episode are partly predicted by income levels before that episode. The estimated process features a time-varying distribution of innovations as well as a factor structure for business cycle exposure. Incorporating the estimated process into a business cycle model adds only one state variable—as in the workhorse persistent-plus-transitory income process—making it a tractable option for modelers.
abstract_zh: 我们估计了一个易于处理的收入过程，该过程与关于个人收入风险及其在经济周期中变化的关键事实相符。具体而言，所估计的过程产生的收入波动表现出：（i）平稳且非周期性的方差，（ii）波动且顺周期的偏度，（iii）极高的峰度，以及（iv）生命周期内同队列不平等程度的适度上升，这些均与美国数据一致。此外，该收入过程捕捉了经济周期收入风险的可预测性：经济周期事件期间收入的变化部分可由该事件前的收入水平预测。所估计的过程具有时变的创新分布以及经济周期暴露的因子结构。将所估计的过程纳入经济周期模型仅需增加一个状态变量——如同标准的持久加暂时收入过程——使其成为建模者的一个易于处理的选择。

title: Impact of gardening and nutrition support provided to women in refugee camps in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh
title_zh: 孟加拉国科克斯巴扎尔难民营妇女园艺与营养支持的影响
title_primary: 孟加拉国科克斯巴扎尔难民营妇女园艺与营养支持的影响
title_secondary: Impact of gardening and nutrition support provided to women in refugee camps in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh
authors: Liz Ignowski, Pepijn Schreinemachers, Md Maniruzzaman, Regine Kopplow, Nasir Md. Uddin 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: • First randomized controlled trial of a home garden and nutrition intervention in a refugee camp. • Trial included 1,050 pregnant/lactating women, equally split between control and treatment. • Garden adoption increased 17 percentage points (pp); share of households eating produce from own garden increased 57 pp. • Household food insecurity reduced by 66%; fruit intake increased, but vegetable intake did not. • The study shows the positive impact of garden interventions despite extreme space constraints in refugee camps. Nearly one million Rohingya refugees, displaced by the Myanmar civil war, live in densely populated camps in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh. While food aid addresses some of their immediate needs, additional solutions are necessary to foster self-reliance, as many have been living in camps for years with little hope of returning home. Gardening is one approach that could enhance diets, food security, and incomes, but evidence for the impact of home garden programs in refugee camps remains limited. The objective of this study is to evaluate the impact of a home garden and nutrition program on the diets and food security of pregnant and lactating women in refugee camps in Cox’s Bazar. A cluster-randomized controlled trial was conducted, with pre- and post-intervention data collected from 1050 women, evenly split into control and treatment groups. A difference-in-differences estimator was used to measure the intent-to-treat effects. Lack of space was the primary obstacle to gardening, but sack gardens and rooftop gardens offered solutions. Women reported many benefits from gardening beyond food consumption, such as personal joy and making the house look nice. The intervention led to a 17-percentage point increase in garden adoption (p = 0.018) and a 57-percentage point rise in households sourcing fruits and vegetables from their gardens (p < 0.001). It also improved nutrition knowledge by 23 percentage points (p < 0.001) and household food security by 66% (p < 0.05). The intervention led to a significant increase of 1 additional serving of fruit per week, but there was no significant increase in vegetable intake. These findings clearly show the benefits of providing gardening and nutrition training to nutritionally vulnerable women in densely populated refugee camps.
abstract_zh: • 首个在难民营中开展的家庭菜园与营养干预的随机对照试验。• 试验纳入1,050名孕妇及哺乳期妇女，对照组与干预组人数均等。• 菜园采用率提高了17个百分点；自产蔬果的家庭比例上升了57个百分点。• 家庭粮食不安全状况降低了66%；水果摄入量增加，但蔬菜摄入量未见显著变化。• 研究表明，尽管难民营空间极为有限，菜园干预仍能产生积极影响。近百万因缅甸内战流离失所的罗兴亚难民，聚居在孟加拉国科克斯巴扎尔人口密集的营地中。虽然食品援助解决了部分即时需求，但许多人已在营地生活多年，返乡希望渺茫，因此需要更多解决方案以促进自力更生。菜园种植是改善饮食、粮食安全和收入的一种途径，但关于难民营中家庭菜园项目效果的证据仍然有限。本研究旨在评估家庭菜园与营养项目对科克斯巴扎尔难民营中孕妇及哺乳期妇女饮食和粮食安全的影响。采用整群随机对照试验设计，在干预前后收集了1,050名妇女的数据，对照组与干预组人数均等。使用双重差分估计量来衡量意向性治疗效果。空间不足是种植的主要障碍，但袋装菜园和屋顶菜园提供了解决方案。妇女们报告了种植带来的诸多非饮食益处，如个人愉悦感和美化居住环境。干预使菜园采用率提高了17个百分点（p = 0.018），自产蔬果的家庭比例上升了57个百分点（p < 0.001）。同时，营养知识水平提高了23个百分点（p < 0.001），家庭粮食安全状况改善了66%（p < 0.05）。干预还使每周水果摄入量显著增加了1份，但蔬菜摄入量未见显著增加。这些发现明确表明，在人口密集的难民营中，为营养脆弱妇女提供菜园种植和营养培训具有显著益处。

authors: Wei Shi, Chunchao Wang, Pei Yu
official: 官方在线 2026-04-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We propose a model for network-mediated interactions incorporating higher-order relationships such as triadic interactions. The marginal utility of an individual's action depends explicitly on endogenous actions of multiple units. Conditions ensuring a unique Nash equilibrium are derived using a variational inequality approach. We estimate the model parameters via maximum likelihood and derive their large sample properties. Applying our model to data from a primary school teamwork experiment in China, we find that the peer effects associated with externally assigned teammates vary depending on preexisting friendship networks. The teamwork intervention enhances peer influence on attitudes while diminishing academic competition among students.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一个模型，用以纳入如三元互动等更高阶关系的网络中介交互。个体行为的边际效用明确依赖于多个单元的内生行为。通过变分不等式方法，我们推导出确保纳什均衡唯一性的条件。我们利用最大似然法估计模型参数，并推导其大样本性质。将我们的模型应用于中国一所小学团队合作实验的数据，我们发现与外部指派队友相关的同伴效应，会因既有友谊网络的不同而有所变化。该团队合作干预增强了同伴对态度的影响，同时减弱了学生间的学业竞争。

abstract: This paper studies a preference revelation game induced by the Efficiency-Adjusted Deferred Acceptance (EDA) mechanism in a priority-based allocation problem. abstract: We study the effects of monetary and fiscal policies when both money and government bonds provide liquidity services. Because money is the unit of account, the price of money is the inverse of the price level. If prices are sticky, so is the price of money in terms of goods, and this is one important reason why money is liquid and attractive. By contrast, the price of government bonds is free to jump and often does, especially in response to news about changes in fiscal policy and the supply of bonds. Those movements in government bond prices affect available liquidity, and therefore aggregate demand, inflation, and output. Under these conditions, bond‐financed fiscal expansions can be contractionary, causing deflation and a temporary recession. To avoid those effects, changes in bond supply must be matched by changes in money supply and in the interest rate on money. We conclude that in a liquidity‐dependent world, fiscal and monetary policies are joined at the hip .
abstract_zh: 我们研究了当货币与政府债券均提供流动性服务时，货币政策与财政政策的影响。由于货币是记账单位，货币的价格是价格水平的倒数。若价格具有粘性，则货币以商品计的价格同样具有粘性，这是货币具有流动性且具吸引力的重要原因之一。相比之下，政府债券的价格可以自由变动，且经常变动，尤其是在对财政政策变化和债券供给新闻的反应中。政府债券价格的这些波动影响可获得的流动性，进而影响总需求、通货膨胀和产出。在此条件下，债券融资的财政扩张可能具有紧缩效应，导致通货紧缩和暂时性衰退。为避免这些影响，债券供给的变化必须与货币供给及货币利率的变化相匹配。我们得出结论：在依赖流动性的世界中，财政政策与货币政策紧密相连。

abstract: This paper examines how training affects productivity across hierarchical layers within organizations. After a randomized training program for frontline employees at a government agency, trained workers’ output increased while their requests for managerial assistance fell. This freed managers to focus on strategic tasks—particularly managers with the strongest connections to trained employees. A structural model of organizational hierarchy shows that spillovers to managers account for approximately 45% of the program’s total benefits, indicating that evaluations focused solely on individual trainees may substantially understate the full value of training investments.
